title: InviteLinkRevokedData
description: data of invite_link.revoked (registry 1.6.0, ADR-0046, PE-38). A lead of the team (or an org owner) withdrew a pending team invite link. tilo-api writes it after the link record changed to revoked, never an agent or a model: actor and target are the person who revoked it, the world is that person's Desk world (PE-12), district is null and vis is [] (owner-only, ADR-0009). Ids only. Expiry and redemption write no revocation. It removes nobody and sends nothing, so it is not a side effect and authz is null.
